summary: Tested Phase 5: PPDB module (public form + admin) and branded Excel exports across 5 endpoints. Backend: 12/13 pytest passed (1 real bug: social-fund/export is not branded due to duplicate route). Frontend: PPDB public form → success screen with 8-char nomor, /admin-ppdb renders with stat cards + list + auto-select + export, sidebar visibility correct per role, login CTA present. 1 missing UI element: UangKas has no export button at all.

critical.issue: Returns UNBRANDED plain-pandas Excel. Route is defined TWICE in /app/backend/server.py — line 672 (old plain pd.to_excel) and line 1207 (new pretty_excel branded). FastAPI keeps the first registration, so the branded version at 1207 is dead code. Verified by inspecting sheet1.xml: 'SEKOLAHKU' marker is absent from social-fund export but present in all other exports (attendance, kas, inventory, ppdb).

ui_bugs.issue: Export Excel button is completely missing from the page. Review request expected data-testid='kas-export-button' to trigger /api/kas/export download. Backend endpoint exists and works (verified with pytest), only frontend button missing.

action_items: DELETE the duplicate route at /app/backend/server.py line 672-681 (old plain-pandas /social-fund/export). Keep only the branded version at line 1207.
ADD Export Excel button to /app/frontend/src/pages/UangKas.jsx with data-testid='kas-export-button' that GETs /api/kas/export as blob and downloads (pattern already used in Inventory.jsx line 42).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: TWO endpoints registered at '/social-fund/export' — silent bug because FastAPI does not warn on duplicate routes. Search for any other duplicate route decorators.
server.py is 1439 lines — consider splitting per resource (ppdb.py, exports.py, etc.) for maintainability.
UangKas.jsx uses static toast import from 'sonner' correctly but doesn't handle export errors (feature missing anyway).
PpdbPublic.jsx form is uncontrolled about NEM min/max — accepts client-side, backend validates 0-100 which is good.

All other Phase 5 features verified working.
rca of the issue: Social-fund export: an older plain pandas export at line 672 was left in place when the branded version was added at line 1207. FastAPI silently accepts duplicate routes and serves the first-registered one. Fix: delete lines 672-681. UangKas export button: developer added backend /api/kas/export and mentioned data-testid='kas-export-button' in review, but never added the button element to UangKas.jsx (the file only contains 'kas-page' and 'uang-kas-add-transaction-button' testids).
